metadata.lesson: Broad static text masks missed photo-wipe caption motion and CTA overshoot. Actual final-frame checks caught both. Per-frame source-letter masks remove English while preserving most original texture; remaining repair bands and unverified separated-audio semantics prevent acceptance. Same-source/local Spanish result only; no general capability or company preference change.
metadata.evidence_semantics: Embedded historical records are immutable observations. Their old path strings are origin labels, not live dependencies. Use only this manifest's files.
metadata.proof_boundary: Preserved text, feedback and actual observed image/audio evidence. Does not preserve every full-video frame or make unobserved claims pass.
